pages.text: Meltdowns and blasts spread $(bold)fallout$(): thin grey-black layers that drift ash. Sealed walls stop it.

pages.title: Contaminated
pages.text: Walk through fallout without a sealed suit and you're $(danger)Contaminated$() until you wash. Milk doesn't clear it.$(br2)Swim in water or use a $(l:radiation/decon_shower)Decontamination Shower$(/l).

pages.title: Airborne
pages.text: Where more than 10 layers lie within 5 blocks, dust hangs in the air. It contaminates unsealed players within 3 blocks and cakes onto EVA visors until washed.

pages.title: Cleanup
pages.text: Shovel fallout up as $(bold)Radioactive Ash$(). The ash is a source too: store it shielded.$(br2)Grass dies and leaves fall where fallout lands.
